text:
This photo shows leftovers rather than a full meal, so I estimated what is still on each dish:

- Bowl at top left: a thin smear of sauce, about 5 g and 5 kcal.
- Bowl at top center: a few corn and carrot pieces, about 30 g and 30 kcal.
- Plate at bottom left: rice or casserole remnants, about 40 g and 60 kcal.
- Plate at bottom center: only a few crumbs, about 2 g and 8 kcal.
- Large plate at right: leftover meat, about 50 g and 100 kcal, plus crumbs, about 5 g and 20 kcal.

Totals come to roughly 132 g and 223 kcal.
